name: claude-switchboard
description: One window for every Claude Code chat across every machine you own: see what each is doing, steer it, restore it after a shutdown, and share the work with a second computer.

scripts.bridge: for x in vscode-bridge vscode-remote vscode-names; do (cd $x && bunx --bun @vscode/vsce@3 package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository -o $x.vsix && code --install-extension $x.vsix --force) || exit 1; done
